editorial_intent: Diagram the targeted delivery of zinc-loaded MXene nanoplatforms crossing prostatic stromal tissue barriers to induce metallothionein-1 genetic expression and quench reactive oxygen species within macrophages.
subject: Ultra-thin 2D titanium carbide MXene sheets shuttling quercetin-bound zinc ions across a dense extracellular matrix stromal barrier, penetrating CD44 receptors on an inflamed macrophage to suppress IKK/NF-κB signaling and neutralize oxidative radical cascades.
setting: Subtle hexagonal fourth-phase water crystal lattice frame intersecting with concentric hydration shells and four laminar drainage sluice vectors woven into the background grid.
composition: Asymmetric Post-Constructivist split-panel lithograph layout showing a structural tissue blockade on the left transitioning into a dynamic intracellular cascade and electron-scavenging visual vector on the right.
